title: Built this tactical card game after a hiatus of 10 years. How did I do?
author: ShenZuBro
selftext:
I was always super interested in card games like war, pokemon, blackjack and Dnd. About 10 years back I think I was playing witcher 3, which got me obsessed with the gwent minigame. Since it was locked to the witcher lore and I couldn't find official merch, I wanted to create my own card game with my own spin and original lore. I got as far as paying for art and music designs, but sadly, life got in the way so I dropped it. Long story short, I finally got around to reviewing my old notes and designs, and made a tactical card game called "TSI: War and Peace" : [https://www.stierideas.com/wpgame](https://www.stierideas.com/wpgame)

Its free to play and comes with a single player and multiplayer. Regarding the latter, keen to hear about any bugs because this took me a while to get right.

I plan to keep this game free and might even add an expansion pack and collab with professional artists depending on the reception.

Either way, let me know if you had fun, and if you have any feedback please feel free to comment or message me!
